protocol: Repair query.sql to select the accepted priority prefix for each tenant/queue. requests(request_id,tenant,queue,priority,units,capacity,status) has unique integer request_id, positive units, nonnegative priority and capacity. All rows within one tenant/queue share capacity. Filter to active rows BEFORE ordering or summing; cancelled rows consume nothing. For each tenant/queue, sort active requests by priority DESC, then request_id ASC. Accept exactly the longest leading prefix whose cumulative units are <= capacity. Once a request exceeds the remaining capacity, stop that queue: do NOT skip it to fit a later small request. Units are strictly positive, so cumulative totals only increase. Equality fits. Queues are independent, even with the same queue name across tenants. Output exactly tenant,queue,request_id,used_units, where used_units is cumulative units through that accepted request. Output rows sorted by SQLite binary tenant ASC, queue ASC, priority DESC, request_id ASC. Empty or all-cancelled queues and queues with no fitting first request produce no rows. No real allocation or external effects. Only query.sql is writable. EXECUTION CONTRACT: At most 10 actions including finish. read paths are exactly README.txt, schema.sql, query.sql, tests/public_cases.json; only query.sql is writable. Every malformed/duplicate-key/invalid action or unauthorized path attempt permanently disqualifies overall pass even if the final SQL is correct. SQL policy violations during test or finish also permanently disqualify. Syntax errors and wrong public outputs may be repaired before finish; finish is final. SQL is a single read-only SQLite statement on requests only, in a fresh in-memory database for each fixture. No recursive CTEs, system tables, ATTACH, PRAGMA, DDL/DML, external functions or extensions. The ONLY admitted function names are sum, lag, row_number, max, min, count, coalesce, ifnull, nullif, typeof, length, lower, upper, abs. Other functions, including lead and dense_rank, are policy violations. CTEs, joins, correlated subqueries, ordinary expressions and these admitted window/aggregate functions may be used within bounds. Query content is 1..8192 UTF-8 bytes with no NUL; action JSON is at most32768 bytes and32 nesting levels. Each SQL execution is interrupted at the next100-step progress callback after50000 counted VM steps or0.25 seconds (not an exact hard wall-time guarantee), expression depth32, compiled operations10000, compound SELECT terms8, output columns16, rows32, total output4096 bytes, individual strings4096 bytes and column names128 bytes. Results allow NULL, strings or integers with absolute value below2^53, not floats/blobs. Exact output names/types/order are graded. Session logical elapsed budget is1000ms supplied by the harness, separate from SQL execution deadlines; local console uses0 logical ms per action and makes no latency claim. No finish means no pass. Overall pass requires final code correctness plus zero invalid interface actions and zero policy violations. test exposes only public fixtures; private tests are not contestant input. The same-user local folder is not a filesystem sandbox.

repository.schema.sql: requests(request_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,tenant TEXT,queue TEXT,priority INTEGER,units INTEGER,capacity INTEGER,status TEXT)
repository.query.sql: SELECT tenant,queue,request_id,units AS used_units FROM requests WHERE status='active' AND units<=capacity ORDER BY tenant,queue,priority DESC,request_id
